abilities.critical_failure: As failure, but the creature becomesenfeebled 2.
abilities.effect: The blood on the floor bubbles vigorously, and as the bubbles burst, waves of toxic gas vent up around the triggering creature. The creature must attempt a DC 30 Fortitude save unless they are holding their breath or don't need to breathe; the hazard then rolls initiative.
abilities.failure: As success, but the creature also becomes enfeebled 1 by the poison gas.
abilities.name: Vent Toxins
abilities.success: The creature becomes sickened 1 by the foul smelling gas.

traits.name: Divine
traits.text:
This magic comes from the divine tradition, drawing power from deities or similar sources. Anything with this trait is magical.  
  
A creature with this trait is primarily constituted of or has a strong connection to divine magic.

traits.name: Conjuration
traits.text: Effects and magic items with this trait are associated with the conjuration school of magic, typically involving summoning, creation, teleportation, or moving things from place to place.

traits.name: Poison
traits.text: An effect with this trait delivers a poison or deals poison damage. An item with this trait is poisonous and might cause an affliction.

abilities.trigger: A creature moves into the room beyond the northern stairs

hazard.description: A churning pool of blood bubbles and seethes, periodically venting noxious vapors into the air.
hazard.disable: Three DC 33 Nature or Occult checks to draw from the blood its magical nature, causing it to clot and become inert, a DC 36 Religion check to offer prayers to sever the sacred link to Kabriri, or *dispel magic* (6th level; counteract DC 29) to render the hazard inert for 10 minutes
hazard.name: Breath of Blood
hazard.reset: The hazard settles back down 1 round after all creatures leave the room and can trigger again at the start of the next round.
hazard.routine: (2 actions) The bubbles furiously sputter and burst on the hazard's first action, filling the air with toxic vapor that inflicts 6d6 poison damage (DC 30 basic Fortitude save) to all creatures in area J3b. A creature that's holding its breath gains a +4 circumstance bonus to this save. On the hazard's second action, the bubbles Vent Toxins at a random target in area J3b.

traits.text: A hazard with this trait takes turns in an encounter.

traits.name: Environmental
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is something dangerous that’s part of the natural world, such as quicksand or harmful mold.
